Count games first. Within a group the second and third ranked players play once each; the winner plays again, against the first ranked player. So the first ranked player and the first-game loser play 1 game; the first-game winner plays 2. The group winner then plays a semi-final and possibly the final. In total there are 4 x 2 + 2 + 1 = 11 games, and the per-player counts in fact 3 add up to 22, which is twice 11.

A group winner who was ranked first has played 1 + 1 = 2 games before the final, 3 if he reaches it. A group winner who was not ranked first has played 3 games by the end of the semi-final, 4 if he reaches the final. Nobody has 4, so both finalists were ranked first and have 3 games, and the two semi-final losers were not ranked first and have 3 games. Hence the four group winners are exactly the 3-game players: Aruna, Biju, Chitra, Dipen. The semi-finals are Aruna v Biju and Chitra v Dipen.

Aruna did not play Arif, but a non-first-ranked winner plays both teammates, so Aruna was ranked first and is a finalist (she beat Azul, who has 2 games). Chetan has 2 games, as the first-game winner who then lost to the top-ranked Chitra, so Chitra was ranked first and is the other finalist; Dipen and Biju were not.
